Returning from the Confederates, the Prophet said to pray Asr only at Bani Quraiza; some delayed it, others prayed on the way, and he blamed neither group.
Returning from the Trench, the Prophet has bathed when Gabriel, dust on his head, says he has not put down arms and points him toward Bani Quraiza.
When Bani Quraiza accept Sa'd's judgement, Sa'd rules that their warriors be killed and their women and children taken prisoner, and the Prophet says he judged as Allah judges.
Gabriel sends the Prophet against Banu Qurayzah, whom Sa'd bin Mu'adh judges: warriors killed, offspring captive; Sa'd dies of his wound, and Hassan is told to abuse them in verse.
The Prophet told the people to stand for Sa'd, whose verdict on Qurayzah, that their warriors be killed and their women and children taken captive, he called Allah's judgement.
